reason: In app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:202, a nil referer becomes `URI('').host`, which is nil, so the request is rejected rather than let through. An attacker's page that frames this one cannot fake the browser-sent Referer, so `X-Frame-Options: ALLOWALL` (line 204) is only sent when the referer's host is the configured embeddable_host. The described clickjacking bypass does not exist.
